verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs index line saying Steel has API endpoints for managing Files, which suggests some file handling exists but gives no detail on how it works. Page-to-PDF and screenshot export are adjacent but are not site file downloads or uploads. Missing for 10: documented capture of browser downloads from sites, documented file upload into site forms or inputs, documented retrieval of artifacts after a session ends, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
